questions.q: Bag A contains x balls and the number of balls in Bag B is $20\%$ more than that of Bag A and the number of balls in Bag C is (x + 15)% more than that of Bag B. If the total number of balls in Bag B and C is 27, find the value of (x*3+10).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, logically soch isko, ye common sense se hi fut jayega. Balls hamesha integer (pure number) hoti hain, adhuri ball toh exist nahi karegi. B, A se $20\%$ (1/5) zyada hai, yani A kam se kam 5 ka multiple hona chahiye. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Hit and trial kar, integer rule lagake. Agar hum $x=10$ (jo ki 5 ka multiple hai) mante hain, toh A = 10, toh B = 12 ho jayega (20% more). Ab C ka dekhte hain: C jo hai wo B se $(10+15)\%$ yani $25\%$ (1/4) zyada hoga. B = 12 ka $25\%$ hota hai 3, toh C = 15. Total B aur C ki sankhya $12+15 = 27$ ho gayi. Condition perfectly match ho gayi! Matlam x = 10 bilkul sahi tha. Pucha hai: $x \times 3 + 10 = 10 \times 3 + 10 = 40$. Bawal approach! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations likhke quadratic solve karega: $B = 1.2x$, $C = 1.2x \times (1 + (x+15)/100)$. Dono ka sum = 27. Itna math exam me nahi karna bhai. Exam Takeaway: Objects ya insaano ko humesha absolute integer hona padta hai, yahi property best shortcut hoti hai.
BagValue Based on x=10
A10
B12
C15

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was 50,000. He used to spend on three heads-personal and family expenses (E), taxes (T), philanthropy (P), and rest were his savings. E was $50\%$ of the income. T was $20\%$ of E and P was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T became $30\%$ of E and P became $20\%$ of T.By what percentage is the new savings more or less than the earlier savings? (correct up to one decimal place)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fir se exam setter ne 50k deke trap set kiya hai. Answer percentage me chahiye, toh initial salary 100 maan, calculation makkhan ki tarah hogi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base I=100. E=50. T(20% of 50)=10. P(15% of 10)=1.5. Old Save = 100-61.5 = 38.5. Nayi Income=140. E wahi 50% rahega yani E=70. Naya T(30% of 70)=21. Naya P(20% of 21)=4.2. New Save = 140-95.2 = 44.8. Diff = 6.3. $\frac{6.3}{38.5}$ nikal ke mark kar!

Mathematically :-
$I_1 = 100, E_1 = 50, T_1 = 10, P_1 = 1.5$
$\text{Save}_1 = 100 - 61.5 = 38.5$
$I_2 = 140, E_2 = 70, T_2 = 21, P_2 = 4.2$
$\text{Save}_2 = 140 - 95.2 = 44.8$
$\text{Diff} = 6.3$
$\% = \frac{6.3}{38.5} \times 100 = 16.36\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pura 50,000 par nikalega, toh end me values hazaaro me chali jayengi fir unka ratio lega toh waise bhi zeros cancel ho jayenge. Gaddha mat khod exam me.

Mathematically :-
$I_1 = 50000$
$\text{Save}_1 = 50000 - 30750 = 19250$
$I_2 = 70000$
$\text{Save}_2 = 70000 - 47600 = 22400$
$\% = \frac{3150}{19250} \times 100 = 16.36\%$

Exam Takeaway: Absolute value avoid kar aur jab parameters interlinked ho, toh bas successive tree banata chal.

StateSavings
Old$38.5$ units
New$44.8$ units

questions.q: Ram's income is $1.25$ times Shyam's expenditure. Shyam's income is $1.33$ times Ram's expenditure. The difference between Shyam's savings and Ram's savings is ₹$3750$. If the ratio of Ram's income to his savings is $5 : 1$, find the value of $3x$ given that Shyam's income is $2x + 10000$.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, $1.33$ ko fraction $\frac{4}{3}$ maan. Jab fractions denominator $3$ aur $1.25$ (yani $\frac{5}{4}$) me chal rahe hain toh base ko 100 ki jagah sidha 300 pakad le taki decimals paida hi na hon.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Shyam Exp} = 300 \\ \text{Ram Inc} = 1.25 \times 300 = 375 \\ \text{Ram Sav} = \frac{375}{5} = 75 \implies \text{Ram Exp} = 375 - 75 = 300 \\ \text{Shyam Inc} = \frac{4}{3} \times 300 = 400 \implies \text{Shyam Sav} = 400 - 300 = 100 \\ \text{Savings Diff} = 100 - 75 = 25 \text{ units} \\ 25 \text{ units} = 3750 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 150 \\ \text{Shyam Inc} = 400 \times 150 = 60000 \\ 2x + 10000 = 60000 \implies x = 25000 \\ 3x = 75000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Future me jab 1.25, 1.33 type multipliers dekhe toh LCM le kar usko main base maan lena.

questions.q: Anuja owns $66 \frac{2}{3}\%$ of a property. If $30\%$ of the property that she owns is worth $1,25,000$, then $45\%$ of the value (in Rs) of the property is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, options aur ratio dekhte hi samajh aana chahiye ki hamein seedha unit se target nikalna hai, $100\%$ ke chakkar me padna hi nahi hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $66 \frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{2}{3}$ aur $30\% = \frac{3}{10}$. Fraction logic se ek line me udana hai isko! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Total} = \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{3}{10} = \frac{1}{5} \\ \frac{1}{5} \rightarrow 1,25,000 \\ 45\% = \frac{9}{20} \\ \frac{9}{20} = \frac{9}{4} \times 1,25,000 = 2,81,250 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total property ko $100x$ maan le. Par ye baccho wala method exam me time khayega. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Anuja} = 66.66x \\ 30\% \text{ of } 66.66x = 20x \\ 20x = 1,25,000 \\ 45x = \frac{1,25,000 \times 45}{20} = 2,81,250 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jaha fraction ki value complex lage, usko percentage me nahi balki ratio fraction (like $\frac{2}{3}$) me convert kar liya kar.

ToolUsage
A. Base Scaling1. Ratio matching without calculating $100\%$ base

questions.q: If $20\%$ of (P+Q) = $50\%$ of (P-Q), then find the ratio P:Q? (CGL TIER I - 17/09/2025 - Shift 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, percentage aur zero dono side baithe hain, seedha uda de. Dimag me hi $2(P+Q) = 5(P-Q)$ banna chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $2P + 2Q = 5P - 5Q$. Ab variables ek taraf kar le. $2Q$ ke paas $-5Q$ aayega toh $7Q$ banega. Aur $5P$ me se $2P$ gaya toh $3P$. Equation aayi $7Q = 3P$. Pucha kya hai? $P:Q$. Seedha palat de, $P:Q = 7:3$. Khel khatam!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Componendo and Dividendo laga sakta hai agar man kare. $\frac{P+Q}{P-Q} = \frac{5}{2}$. Phir $\frac{P}{Q} = \frac{5+2}{5-2} = \frac{7}{3}$. Ye bhi ek solid tarika hai concept build karne ka.

Exam Takeaway: CGL Tier 1 me aisi speed maintain karni padegi, step-by-step likhne me rank haath se nikal jayegi.

ExpressionSimplified Form
A. Left Hand Side1. $2(P+Q)$
B. Right Hand Side2. $5(P-Q)$

questions.q: The income of Raman is Rs. 75400. He saves 23% of his income. If his income is increased by 27% and expenditure by 50%, then find the decrease in his savings.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling & 3. JSM

Pen-Free Observation: Income ko 100 units maan le. Jeb mein aaye $27$, par kharcha badha $38.5$. Toh extra kahan se aayega? Teri Saving se katenge!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Decrease base shift se nikal kar seedha Unitary scaling se mark kar.

Mathematically :-
$$ I = 100, \\ S = 23, \\ E = 77 \\\\ \\Delta I = +27 \\\\ \\Delta E = 77 \\times 50\\% = +38.5 \\\\ \\Delta S = 27 - 38.5 = -11.5 \\ units \\\\ Value = 75400 \\times 11.5\\% = 8671 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Tera Deviation Method. Percentage change in Saving nikala jo ki $-50\%$ aaya aur fir wapas original par lagaya.

Mathematically :-
$$ S_{\\%} = 27\\% + \\frac{(27-50) \\times 77}{23}\\% = -50\\% \\\\ Value = (75400 \\times 23\\%) \\times 50\\% \\\\ = 17342 \\times 0.5 = 8671 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab absolute value (Rs.) mein puche toh Method 1 better hai, percent change puche toh Deviation better hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Saving ko $100$ maan le. Expenditure usse $40\%$ jyada yani $140$ hoga. Secondon me uda diya bina algebra lagaye!

Mathematically :-
$$ S = x \\\\ E = 1.4x \\\\ I = 2.4x = 72000 \\\\ x = 30000 $$

questions.q: In a gaming season, a player has played 40 ranked matches so far and won $30 \%$ of them. If he wins $60 \%$ of the remaining matches, his overall win percentage will be $50 \%$. Suppose he wins $90 \%$ of the remaining matches, then the total number of matches won by the player in the season will be?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Jeet percentage $30 \%$ se $50 \%$ karni hai aur naye matches me $60 \%$ jeet raha hai. Alligation se purane aur naye matches ka ratio nikalo aur bache hue nikal lo.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Alligation laga kar quantities ka ratio nikalte hain. Pura calculation verbally ho jayega.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Ratio of New to Old matches} \\ \frac{50 \% - 30 \%}{60 \% - 50 \%} = \frac{20}{10} = 2:1 \\ \text{Old matches (1 unit)} = 40 \\ \text{New matches (2 units)} = 80 \\ \text{Total won} = (40 \times 30 \%) + (80 \times 90 \%) \\ = 12 + 72 = 84 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation se balance karo. Total wins equal to final percentage of total matches.

Mathematically :-

$$ 12 + 0.6X = 0.5(40 + X) \\ 12 + 0.6X = 20 + 0.5X \\ 0.1X = 8 \implies X = 80 \\ \text{New wins} = 80 \times 90 \% = 72 \\ \text{Total wins} = 12 + 72 = 84 $$

Exam Takeaway: Alligation is the fastest way to find ratio of quantities when two mixtures/averages merge. Hamesha direct cross-subtract karo.

MethodTime Taken
Alligation (Ninja)10-15s
Basic Equation30-40s

questions.q: A student gets a total of $80\%$ marks overall in five subjects, where the marks obtained are in the ratio of 10:8:6:4:2. If the passing marks for each subject are $30\%$ of the maximum marks, and the maximum marks for each subject are the same, then in how many subjects does he pass the examination?
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, agar marks ko 100 manoge toh decimals mein phasoge. Ratio ka sum 30 hai, toh base 30 pakad taki unitary method naturally set ho jaye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Max Marks per subject} = 30 \implies \text{Total Max} = 150 \\ \text{Overall Obtained} = 80\% \times 150 = 120 \text{ marks} \\ \text{Total Ratio Units} = 10+8+6+4+2 = 30 \text{ units} \\ 30 \text{ units} = 120 \text{ marks} \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 4 \text{ marks} \\ \text{Passing Limit} = 30\% \times 30 = 9 \text{ marks} \\ \text{Lowest score} = 2 \times 4 = 8 \text{ marks } (< 9 \implies \text{Fail}) \\ \text{2nd Lowest} = 4 \times 4 = 16 \text{ marks } (> 9 \implies \text{Pass}) $$

Exam Takeaway: Iska matlab sirf sabse kam marks wale mein fail hua, baaki 4 subjects mein pass!

questions.q: In a factory with 400 employees, the ratio of the number of male employees to that of female employees is 5:3. There are $87.5\%$ regular employees in the factory. If $92\%$ of male employees are regular employees, then what is the percentage of regular female employees?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, total $400$ employees sirf daraane aur exam ka time kharab karne ke liye diye hain. Jab final answer percentage me pucha ho aur initial data ratio aur $\%$ me ho, absolute value chhuo bhi mat.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): M:F ka ratio $5:3$ hai. Overall regular average ko base maan aur deviation check kar. Bin pen ud gaya sawal!

Mathematically :-
$$ M:F = 5:3 \\\\ Avg_{total} = 87.5\\% \\\\ Dev_M = 92\\% - 87.5\\% = +4.5\\% \\\\ Total \\ Dev_M = 5 \\times 4.5\\% = +22.5\\% \\\\ Dev_F = \\frac{-22.5\\%}{3} = -7.5\\% \\\\ F\\% = 87.5\\% - 7.5\\% = 80\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Gadha mazdoori mode on kar: pehle values nikal fir minus karke percentage. Bahot lamba.

Mathematically :-
$$ M = 250, \\ F = 150 \\\\ M_{reg} = 250 \\times 92\\% = 230 \\\\ Total_{reg} = 400 \\times 87.5\\% = 350 \\\\ F_{reg} = 350 - 230 = 120 \\\\ F\\% = \\frac{120}{150} \\times 100 = 80\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM aur deviation weighted mean ka baap hai, jab absolute figure ki jarurat na ho, ratio pe chipke raho.

questions.q: A monkey is trying to climb up a pole with height 20 meters. Every minute the monkey climbs up by 3 meters and in the next 30 seconds it slips down by 1 meter. In how much time it will reach the top of the pole if initially the monkey was at the bottom of the pole?
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Logical Scaling (Cycle Method)]

Pen-Free Observation: Monkey jab ek baar top par pahaunch jayega, toh wo phislega kyu? Isiliye hamesha total height se last ki 1 upward jump ($3\text{m}$) minus karke (yani 17m tak) cycles ginte hain.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
1 Cycle $= 1 \text{ min}$ (up) $+ 30 \text{ sec}$ (down) $= 1.5 \text{ minutes}$.
Net distance in 1 Cycle $= +3 - 1 = 2 \text{ meters}$.
Target without last jump $= 20 - 3 = 17 \text{ meters}$.
17 meter tak pahaunchne ke liye total cycles: 8 cycle (yani 16m). Par 9 cycle tak jayenge toh 18m par jayega.
Let's take 9 full cycles:
$9 \text{ cycles}$ me $= 9 \times 2 = 18 \text{ meters}$. Time $= 9 \times 1.5 = 13.5 \text{ minutes}$.
Ab wo $18\text{m}$ par baitha hai. Top hai $20\text{m}$ par. Use jana hai sirf $2\text{m}$.
Uski climbing speed hai $3 \text{ meters per minute}$.
2 meter jane me laga time $= \frac{2}{3} \text{ minute} = 40 \text{ seconds}$.
Total time $= 13 \text{ min } 30 \text{ sec} + 40 \text{ sec} = 14 \text{ min } 10 \text{ sec}$.

Takeaway: Hamesha check karo cycle tootne ke baad bacha hua distance normal speed se kitni der me cross hoga. SSC CGL ka favourite trap hai ye!

questions.q: A rectangular portion of a warehouse floor was getting repaired for which an estimate was made on the basis of a rate of Rs. R per square unit. But while doing the work, the length of the portion got increased by $10 \%$ and the breadth by $8 \%$. Over and above this, there was an increase in the cost of the repair work to the extent of $15 \%$. What was the overall percentage increase in the cost of repair over the estimate?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Area (Length $\times$ Breadth) aur Rate sab multiply hote hain total cost nikalne ke liye. Toh teeno $10 \%$, $8 \%$, aur $15 \%$ successive increase lagana hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Multipliers ko directly multiply karke decimal value dekho.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Net Multiplier} = 1.10 \times 1.08 \times 1.15 \\ 1.10 \times 1.08 = 1.188 \\ 1.188 \times 1.15 = 1.3662 \\ \text{Final Value} = 1.3662 \text{ times of initial} \\ \text{Increase} = 1.3662 - 1 = 0.3662 = 36.62 \% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $X + Y + \frac{XY}{100}$ wala formula do baar lagao.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Area increase } (10 \% \text{ and } 8 \%) = 10 + 8 + \frac{10 \times 8}{100} \\ = 18.8 \% \\ \text{Total cost increase } (18.8 \% \text{ and } 15 \%) = 18.8 + 15 + \frac{18.8 \times 15}{100} \\ = 33.8 + \frac{282}{100} \\ = 33.8 + 2.82 = 36.62 \% $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab teen variables badhte hain aur numbers asan hon, toh unka $1.x$ form multiplier nikal kar direct multiply karna $x+y$ formula se fast hota hai.

FactorMultiplier
Length ($10 \% \uparrow$)1.10
Breadth ($8 \% \uparrow$)1.08
Rate ($15 \% \uparrow$)1.15

questions.q: Three candidates P, Q and R contested an election. Out of the total votes on a voter list $25\%$ did not vote and $20\%$ of the polled votes were invalid. R got 7500 votes which were $25\%$ more than that of what Q got. If P got only $45\%$ of the total votes, then find out the number of votes the winner got?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Chain Process Breakdown)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 'Valid votes' ka distribution bada lamba fraction set le raha hai. Ulta mat soch, percentage flow ke order me bas fractions kaat-te ja.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total list maan lo $100\%$. Valid residual nikalo aur Q+R ke sum ko balance bache % se equate karo. Boom!

Mathematically :-
$$ Total = 100\\% \\\\ Valid = 100\\% \\times 0.75 \\times 0.80 = 60\\% \\\\ Q = \\frac{7500}{1.25} = 6000 \\\\ Q + R = 13500 \\\\ P = 45\\% \\implies Q+R = 60\\% - 45\\% = 15\\% \\\\ 15\\% = 13500 \\implies 45\\% = 40500 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pure equations maan kar solve karo. Exam nikalne ki umeed chod dena tab!

Mathematically :-
$$ Valid = x \\times 0.75 \\times 0.8 = 0.6x \\\\ P = 0.45x \\\\ Q+R = 0.6x - 0.45x = 0.15x \\\\ 0.15x = 13500 \\implies x = 90000 \\\\ P = 0.45 \\times 90000 = 40500 $$

Exam Takeaway: Aise lambe statements ko line diagram aur valid % residual calculation se todna sabse powerful technique hai.

B. Candidate P's Share2. $45\%$

questions.q: Last year, Geeta's monthly salary was 12,000 and Seeta's monthly salary was 10,000. This year, Geeta's monthly salary is $\text{Rs. } 14$,400, while Seeta's monthly salary is $\text{Rs. } 12$,500. If the percentage increase in Seeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by x%, and the percentage increase in Geeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by y%, then what is the value of ((x-y)/y * 100) % ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, lambe zeroes ko ignore kar. 12 se 14.4 aur 10 se 12.5 ka increment nikal aur direct fraction formule me daal de.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Zero cut ratio. Mathematically :-
$$y = \frac{2.4}{12} \times 100 = 20\%$$
$$x = \frac{2.5}{10} \times 100 = 25\%$$
$$\frac{25-20}{20} \times 100 = 25\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard percentage change. Mathematically :-
$$y = \frac{14400 - 12000}{12000} \times 100 = 20\%$$
$$x = \frac{12500 - 10000}{10000} \times 100 = 25\%$$
$$\frac{x-y}{y} \times 100 = \frac{5}{20} \times 100 = 25\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Lambi statement me specific variable pe focus kar aur zero neglect mar ke speed badha.

questions.q: A has some coins. He gives half of the coins and 3 more to B. B gives half of the coins and 3 more to C. C gives half of the coins and 3 more to D. The number of coins D has now is the smallest two digit number. How many coins does A have in the beginning?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, aage se jaayega (x maan ke) toh equation me ulajh jayega. D ka final number pata hai (10). Peeche se ulta chalna start kar, options apne aap eliminate honge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse operations laga. D ke paas 10 hain. C ne aadhe diye aur 3 aur diye, toh pehle 3 wapas le (10-3=7) fir double kar (14). Same B aur A ke liye repeat maar. Mind me calculate hoga!

Mathematically :-
$D = 10$
$C = (10 - 3) \times 2 = 14$
$B = (14 - 3) \times 2 = 22$
$A = (22 - 3) \times 2 = 38$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar equation banayega toh step-by-step variables lene padenge. Ise solve karna exam me maut hai. Reverse logic hi tera sahara hai.

Mathematically :-
$\frac{\frac{\frac{x}{2} - 3}{2} - 3}{2} - 3 = 10$
$x = 38$

Exam Takeaway: Chain sharing wale questions me hamesha end point se reverse gear daal diya kar!

questions.q: Ramesh can save $30\%$ of his income but after 4 years, his income increases by $42\%$ and he still manages to save the same amount as before. What is the percent increase in his expenditure ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, savings bilkul same hai matlab jitni income badhi, utna hi paisa pura kharche me chala gaya. Seedha base se divide maar!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct absolute deviation. Mathematically :-
$$I = 100, S = 30, E = 70$$
$$\Delta I = 42 \Rightarrow \Delta E = 42$$
$$\% \Delta E = \frac{42}{70} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic scaling map. Mathematically :-
$$New\_I = 142, New\_S = 30$$
$$New\_E = 142 - 30 = 112$$
$$Inc = 112 - 70 = 42$$
$$\frac{42}{70} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Constant saving ke case me direct change in income ko Expenditure ka change maan liya kar.

List IList II
Direct EqualityWhen Savings is constant, Absolute Increase in I = Absolute Increase in E.

questions.q: If the price of a product increases by $25\%$, by what percent should the consumption be reduced to keep the expenditure same? (CHSL TIER I - 28/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye questions dekh kar solve nahi hote, inko tick karke aage badhna hota hai. $25\%$ yani $\frac{1}{4}$ ki badhotari matlab ghataav $\frac{1}{5}$ ka hoga!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR Jindabad! Pen uthane ki zaroorat hi nahi thi mere bhai! Mathematically :- $$ P \uparrow 25\% = +\frac{1}{4} \\ C \downarrow -\frac{1}{4+1} = -\frac{1}{5} \\ -\frac{1}{5} = 20\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula $P \times C = E$. Maan le pehle price $100$ aur consumption $100$ tha, toh expenditure $10,000$ hua. questions.q: If the volume of a cube increases by $119.7\%$, what is the percentage change in its total surface area?

Hamein 2D (Surface Area) chahiye, toh side ka square kar de: $10^2 : 13^2 = 100 : 169$. $100$ se $169$ ho jana matlab direct $69\%$ ki vridhi. Ye cubes 15 tak raate hone chahiye bhai! Multiplier $1.69$ aagaya, jiska matlab $+69\%$ hota hai. Exam Takeaway: $10\%$, $20\%$, $30\%$ ke 3 saal ke CI / Volume multipliers dimag me chap le. Jaise hi 219.7 dikha, $30\%$ (1.3) yaad aana chahiye.

[Core Tool Triggered: Successive Change (Chain Reaction)]

questions.q: Volume of a cylinder is increased by 43% when its height is reduced by 15 5/13% then find % change in CSA of cylinder?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Volume $V \propto r^2 h$ hota hai. $V$ ka naya ratio $= \frac{143}{100}$. $h$ ka ratio 13 se 11 ho gaya yani $\frac{11}{13}$.
$$r^2 = \frac{V}{h} = \frac{143/100}{11/13} = \frac{169}{100}$$
Iska matlab $r = \frac{13}{10}$. Ab CSA hota hai $2\pi rh$ jo depend karta hai $r \times h$ par.
CSA Ratio $= \frac{13}{10} \times \frac{11}{13} = \frac{11}{10}$. 10 se 11 ho gaya, seedha $10\%$ increment!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula ratne ki zarurat nahi hai. Volume radius ke square par depend karti hai aur CSA linear hota hai. Bas in multipliers ko dhyan me rakhna hai.

Exam Takeaway: Mensuration ke percentage questions me constants ($2\pi$) ko hamesha ignore maar aur bas proportional ratios use kar.

questions.q: Kavita owns a commercial property which she let on lease to a third party for five years. Instead of just the lease income, she also gets a fixed annual salary of Rs. 6,00,000. In five years, the total lease income from the property is exactly $50 \%$ of her annual salary. How much money does she earn in total each year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Annual salary 6 lakh hai. 5 saal ki land income uski ek saal ki salary ka $50 \%$ yani 3 lakh hai. Toh usko property se har saal 60 hazar milte hain. Bacha wala part add kar do.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Seedha verbal logic aur arithmetic lagana hai, koi extra variable nahi chahiye.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Annual Salary} = 6,00,000 \\ \text{5-Year Lease Income} = 50 \% \text{ of } 6,00,000 = 3,00,000 \\ \text{1-Year Lease Income} = \frac{3,00,000}{5} = 60,000 \\ \text{Total Annual Earning} = 6,00,000 + 60,000 = 6,60,000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Mathematical equation balance karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let } S = 600000 \\ \text{Let Annual Lease} = L \\ 5 \times L = 0.5 \times S \\ 5L = 0.5 \times 600000 = 300000 \\ L = 60000 \\ \text{Total Earning per year} = S + L = 600000 + 60000 = 660000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Language reading is everything here. In 5 years total lease income di gayi thi, jise 1 year par scale-down karna zaroori tha before adding.

questions_hin.q_hi: Ram's income is $1.25$ times Shyam's expenditure. Shyam's income is $1.33$ times Ram's expenditure. The difference between Shyam's savings and Ram's savings is ₹$3750$. If the ratio of Ram's income to his savings is $5 : 1$, find the value of $3x$ given that Shyam's income is $2x + 10000$.
questions_hin.s_hi:
Tool Triggered: 5. Unitary Scaling

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, $1.33$ ko fraction $\frac{4}{3}$ maan. Jab fractions denominator $3$ aur $1.25$ (yani $\frac{5}{4}$) me chal rahe hain toh base ko 100 ki jagah sidha 300 pakad le taki decimals paida hi na hon.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let Shyam Exp} = 300 \\ \text{Ram Inc} = 1.25 \times 300 = 375 \\ \text{Ram Sav} = \frac{375}{5} = 75 \implies \text{Ram Exp} = 375 - 75 = 300 \\ \text{Shyam Inc} = \frac{4}{3} \times 300 = 400 \implies \text{Shyam Sav} = 400 - 300 = 100 \\ \text{Savings Diff} = 100 - 75 = 25 \text{ units} \\ 25 \text{ units} = 3750 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 150 \\ \text{Shyam Inc} = 400 \times 150 = 60000 \\ 2x + 10000 = 60000 \implies x = 25000 \\ 3x = 75000 $$

questions_hin.q_hi: In a gaming season, a player has played 40 ranked matches so far and won $30 \%$ of them. If he wins $60 \%$ of the remaining matches, his overall win percentage will be $50 \%$. Suppose he wins $90 \%$ of the remaining matches, then the total number of matches won by the player in the season will be?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Jeet percentage $30 \%$ se $50 \%$ karni hai aur naye matches me $60 \%$ jeet raha hai. Alligation se purane aur naye matches ka ratio nikalo aur bache hue nikal lo.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Alligation laga kar quantities ka ratio nikalte hain. Pura calculation verbally ho jayega.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Ratio of New to Old matches} \\ \frac{50 \% - 30 \%}{60 \% - 50 \%} = \frac{20}{10} = 2:1 \\ \text{Old matches (1 unit)} = 40 \\ \text{New matches (2 units)} = 80 \\ \text{Total won} = (40 \times 30 \%) + (80 \times 90 \%) \\ = 12 + 72 = 84 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic equation se balance karo. Total wins equal to final percentage of total matches.

Mathematically :-

$$ 12 + 0.6X = 0.5(40 + X) \\ 12 + 0.6X = 20 + 0.5X \\ 0.1X = 8 \implies X = 80 \\ \text{New wins} = 80 \times 90 \% = 72 \\ \text{Total wins} = 12 + 72 = 84 $$

Exam Takeaway: Alligation is the fastest way to find ratio of quantities when two mixtures/averages merge. Hamesha direct cross-subtract karo.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):

questions_hin.q_hi: In a factory with 400 employees, the ratio of the number of male employees to that of female employees is 5:3. There are $87.5\%$ regular employees in the factory. If $92\%$ of male employees are regular employees, then what is the percentage of regular female employees?

Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, total $400$ employees sirf daraane aur exam ka time kharab karne ke liye diye hain. Jab final answer percentage me pucha ho aur initial data ratio aur $\%$ me ho, absolute value chhuo bhi mat.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): M:F ka ratio $5:3$ hai. Overall regular average ko base maan aur deviation check kar. Bin pen ud gaya sawal!

Mathematically :-
$$ M:F = 5:3 \\\\ Avg_{total} = 87.5\\% \\\\ Dev_M = 92\\% - 87.5\\% = +4.5\\% \\\\ Total \\ Dev_M = 5 \\times 4.5\\% = +22.5\\% \\\\ Dev_F = \\frac{-22.5\\%}{3} = -7.5\\% \\\\ F\\% = 87.5\\% - 7.5\\% = 80\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Gadha mazdoori mode on kar: pehle values nikal fir minus karke percentage. Bahot lamba.

Mathematically :-
$$ M = 250, \\ F = 150 \\\\ M_{reg} = 250 \\times 92\\% = 230 \\\\ Total_{reg} = 400 \\times 87.5\\% = 350 \\\\ F_{reg} = 350 - 230 = 120 \\\\ F\\% = \\frac{120}{150} \\times 100 = 80\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM aur deviation weighted mean ka baap hai, jab absolute figure ki jarurat na ho, ratio pe chipke raho.

questions_hin.q_hi: A monkey is trying to climb up a pole with height 20 meters. Every minute the monkey climbs up by 3 meters and in the next 30 seconds it slips down by 1 meter. In how much time it will reach the top of the pole if initially the monkey was at the bottom of the pole?
questions_hin.s_hi:
[Core Tool Triggered: Logical Scaling (Cycle Method)]

Pen-Free Observation: Monkey jab ek baar top par pahaunch jayega, toh wo phislega kyu? Isiliye hamesha total height se last ki 1 upward jump ($3\text{m}$) minus karke (yani 17m tak) cycles ginte hain.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
1 Cycle $= 1 \text{ min}$ (up) $+ 30 \text{ sec}$ (down) $= 1.5 \text{ minutes}$.
Net distance in 1 Cycle $= +3 - 1 = 2 \text{ meters}$.
Target without last jump $= 20 - 3 = 17 \text{ meters}$.
17 meter tak pahaunchne ke liye total cycles: 8 cycle (yani 16m). Par 9 cycle tak jayenge toh 18m par jayega.
Let's take 9 full cycles:
$9 \text{ cycles}$ me $= 9 \times 2 = 18 \text{ meters}$. Time $= 9 \times 1.5 = 13.5 \text{ minutes}$.
Ab wo $18\text{m}$ par baitha hai. Top hai $20\text{m}$ par. Use jana hai sirf $2\text{m}$.
Uski climbing speed hai $3 \text{ meters per minute}$.
2 meter jane me laga time $= \frac{2}{3} \text{ minute} = 40 \text{ seconds}$.
Total time $= 13 \text{ min } 30 \text{ sec} + 40 \text{ sec} = 14 \text{ min } 10 \text{ sec}$.

Takeaway: Hamesha check karo cycle tootne ke baad bacha hua distance normal speed se kitni der me cross hoga. SSC CGL ka favourite trap hai ye!

questions_hin.q_hi: A rectangular portion of a warehouse floor was getting repaired for which an estimate was made on the basis of a rate of Rs. R per square unit. But while doing the work, the length of the portion got increased by $10 \%$ and the breadth by $8 \%$. Over and above this, there was an increase in the cost of the repair work to the extent of $15 \%$. What was the overall percentage increase in the cost of repair over the estimate?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Area (Length $\times$ Breadth) aur Rate sab multiply hote hain total cost nikalne ke liye. Toh teeno $10 \%$, $8 \%$, aur $15 \%$ successive increase lagana hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Multipliers ko directly multiply karke decimal value dekho.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Net Multiplier} = 1.10 \times 1.08 \times 1.15 \\ 1.10 \times 1.08 = 1.188 \\ 1.188 \times 1.15 = 1.3662 \\ \text{Final Value} = 1.3662 \text{ times of initial} \\ \text{Increase} = 1.3662 - 1 = 0.3662 = 36.62 \% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $X + Y + \frac{XY}{100}$ wala formula do baar lagao.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Area increase } (10 \% \text{ and } 8 \%) = 10 + 8 + \frac{10 \times 8}{100} \\ = 18.8 \% \\ \text{Total cost increase } (18.8 \% \text{ and } 15 \%) = 18.8 + 15 + \frac{18.8 \times 15}{100} \\ = 33.8 + \frac{282}{100} \\ = 33.8 + 2.82 = 36.62 \% $$

Exam Takeaway: Jab teen variables badhte hain aur numbers asan hon, toh unka $1.x$ form multiplier nikal kar direct multiply karna $x+y$ formula se fast hota hai.

FactorMultiplier
Length ($10 \% \uparrow$)1.10
Breadth ($8 \% \uparrow$)1.08
Rate ($15 \% \uparrow$)1.15

questions_hin.q_hi: Three candidates P, Q and R contested an election. Out of the total votes on a voter list $25\%$ did not vote and $20\%$ of the polled votes were invalid. R got 7500 votes which were $25\%$ more than that of what Q got. If P got only $45\%$ of the total votes, then find out the number of votes the winner got?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Chain Process Breakdown)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 'Valid votes' ka distribution bada lamba fraction set le raha hai. Ulta mat soch, percentage flow ke order me bas fractions kaat-te ja.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total list maan lo $100\%$. Valid residual nikalo aur Q+R ke sum ko balance bache % se equate karo. Boom!

Mathematically :-
$$ Total = 100\\% \\\\ Valid = 100\\% \\times 0.75 \\times 0.80 = 60\\% \\\\ Q = \\frac{7500}{1.25} = 6000 \\\\ Q + R = 13500 \\\\ P = 45\\% \\implies Q+R = 60\\% - 45\\% = 15\\% \\\\ 15\\% = 13500 \\implies 45\\% = 40500 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pure equations maan kar solve karo. Exam nikalne ki umeed chod dena tab!

Mathematically :-
$$ Valid = x \\times 0.75 \\times 0.8 = 0.6x \\\\ P = 0.45x \\\\ Q+R = 0.6x - 0.45x = 0.15x \\\\ 0.15x = 13500 \\implies x = 90000 \\\\ P = 0.45 \\times 90000 = 40500 $$

Exam Takeaway: Aise lambe statements ko line diagram aur valid % residual calculation se todna sabse powerful technique hai.

If the percentage increase in Seeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by x%, and the percentage increase in Geeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by y%, then what is the value of ((x-y)/y * 100) % ?

$$x = \frac{12500 - 10000}{10000} \times 100 = 25\%$$

questions_hin.q_hi: A has some coins. He gives half of the coins and 3 more to B. B gives half of the coins and 3 more to C. C gives half of the coins and 3 more to D. The number of coins D has now is the smallest two digit number. How many coins does A have in the beginning?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, aage se jaayega (x maan ke) toh equation me ulajh jayega. D ka final number pata hai (10). Peeche se ulta chalna start kar, options apne aap eliminate honge.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse operations laga. D ke paas 10 hain. C ne aadhe diye aur 3 aur diye, toh pehle 3 wapas le (10-3=7) fir double kar (14). Same B aur A ke liye repeat maar. Mind me calculate hoga!

Mathematically :-
$D = 10$
$C = (10 - 3) \times 2 = 14$
$B = (14 - 3) \times 2 = 22$
$A = (22 - 3) \times 2 = 38$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar equation banayega toh step-by-step variables lene padenge. Ise solve karna exam me maut hai. Reverse logic hi tera sahara hai.

Mathematically :-
$\frac{\frac{\frac{x}{2} - 3}{2} - 3}{2} - 3 = 10$
$x = 38$

questions_hin.q_hi: Ramesh can save $30\%$ of his income but after 4 years, his income increases by $42\%$ and he still manages to save the same amount as before. What is the percent increase in his expenditure ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, savings bilkul same hai matlab jitni income badhi, utna hi paisa pura kharche me chala gaya. Seedha base se divide maar!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct absolute deviation. Mathematically :-
$$I = 100, S = 30, E = 70$$
$$\Delta I = 42 \Rightarrow \Delta E = 42$$
$$\% \Delta E = \frac{42}{70} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic scaling map. Mathematically :-
$$New\_I = 142, New\_S = 30$$
$$New\_E = 142 - 30 = 112$$
$$Inc = 112 - 70 = 42$$
$$\frac{42}{70} \times 100 = 60\%$$

questions_hin.q_hi: If the price of a product increases by $25\%$, by what percent should the consumption be reduced to keep the expenditure same? (CHSL TIER I - 28/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye questions dekh kar solve nahi hote, inko tick karke aage badhna hota hai. $25\%$ yani $\frac{1}{4}$ ki badhotari matlab ghataav $\frac{1}{5}$ ka hoga!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR Jindabad! Pen uthane ki zaroorat hi nahi thi mere bhai! Mathematically :- $$ P \uparrow 25\% = +\frac{1}{4} \\ C \downarrow -\frac{1}{4+1} = -\frac{1}{5} \\ -\frac{1}{5} = 20\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula $P \times C = E$. Maan le pehle price $100$ aur consumption $100$ tha, toh expenditure $10,000$ hua. Mathematically :- $$ P_1 \times C_1 = E_1 \implies 100 \times 100 = 10000 \\ 125 \times C_2 = 10000 \\ C_2 = \frac{10000}{125} = 80 \\ \% \text{ reduction} = \frac{100-80}{100} \times 100 = 20\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Constant expenditure dekhte hi AB Rule (CPR) ki machine ghooma do, formulas nahi lagane yahan.

questions_hin.q_hi: If the volume of a cube increases by $119.7\%$, what is the percentage change in its total surface area?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Volume 3D ($x^3$) me chalta hai aur Area 2D ($x^2$) me. Tujhe cube root lekar side pe aana hai fir square karke area nikalna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Volume $100$ se badh kar $219.7$ ho gaya. Zero shift kar de toh ratio banega $1000 : 2197$. Ye kiske cube hain? $10^3$ aur $13^3$. Yani cube ki side 10 se 13 ho gayi. Hamein 2D (Surface Area) chahiye, toh side ka square kar de: $10^2 : 13^2 = 100 : 169$. $100$ se $169$ ho jana matlab direct $69\%$ ki vridhi. Ye cubes 15 tak raate hone chahiye bhai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Side $= a$. Naya volume $= 2.197 a^3$. Nayi side $= \sqrt[3]{2.197} a = 1.3 a$. Purana Surface Area $= 6a^2$. Naya Surface Area $= 6(1.3a)^2 = 6 \times 1.69 a^2$. Multiplier $1.69$ aagaya, jiska matlab $+69\%$ hota hai. Exam Takeaway: $10\%$, $20\%$, $30\%$ ke 3 saal ke CI / Volume multipliers dimag me chap le. Jaise hi 219.7 dikha, $30\%$ (1.3) yaad aana chahiye.

1. Volume (3D)2.197 ($13^3 / 10^3$)
2. Side (1D)1.3 ($13 / 10$)
3. Area (2D)1.69 ($+69\%$)

questions_hin.q_hi: Annually income of Arun is 6.24 lakh, he spend $38\frac{6}{13}\%$ of monthly income on Food and Rent, $12.5\%$ of remaining on Gym, $14\frac{2}{7}\%$ of remaining on clothing and $75\%$ of remaining invested in mutual fund. if he kept remaining amount after all expense as cash with him then find how much cash Arun have after one year?
questions_hin.s_hi:
[Core Tool Triggered: Successive Change (Chain Reaction)]

Pen-Free Observation: Har jagah 'remaining' use hua hai, matlab successive multiplier lagega. Fractions yaad hain toh ek line ka question hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
$38\frac{6}{13}\% = \frac{5}{13} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{8}{13}$.
$12.5\% = \frac{1}{8} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{7}{8}$.
$14\frac{2}{7}\% = \frac{1}{7} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{6}{7}$.
$75\% = \frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{1}{4}$.
Multiply karke total remaining fraction nikal: $\frac{8}{13} \times \frac{7}{8} \times \frac{6}{7} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{6}{52} = \frac{3}{26}$.
Total income $6,24,000$ hai. Cash $= 624000 \times \frac{3}{26} = 24000 \times 3 = 72000 \text{ Rs}$.

Takeaway: Jab initial value aur final value ki baat ho toh chain reaction best tool hai.

questions_hin.q_hi: In a class of 60 students, $40\%$ are girls. The average weight of boys is 62 kg and that of girls is 55 kg. What is the average weight of the whole class?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 60 students mazdoori karne ke liye diya hai. Total bacho se hume koi matlab nahi, sirf ratio se khelna hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Girls $40\%$ toh Boys $60\%$. Ratio Boys:Girls $= 3:2$. JSM method lagayenge. Maan le puri class ka average $55$ hai. Ab Boys ka average $62$ hai, yani $55$ se $7$ zyada. $3$ ladko pe total deviation aaya $+21$. Is total deviation ko total baccho ($3+2 = 5$) me baant de. $+21/5 = +4.2$. Base 55 me ye 4.2 jod de, final average $59.2$ kg. Pen-free hack!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Weighted average ka basic laga le. Total bacche $5$ unit hain. Total sum $= 3 \times 62 + 2 \times 55 = 186 + 110 = 296$. Average $= \frac{296}{5} = 59.2$ kg. Number chote the toh ye bhi jaldi ho jata.

Exam Takeaway: Absolute values tabhi use karni hain jab absolute answer pucha ho. Averages aur percentages hamesha ratio par nikal jate hain.

questions_hin.q_hi: Volume of a cylinder is increased by 43% when its height is reduced by 15 5/13% then find % change in CSA of cylinder?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Fractions pe teri pakad ekdum solid honi chahiye. $15 \frac{5}{13}\%$ dekhte hi dimaag me $\frac{2}{13}$ aana chahiye. Aur 43% (yani 143) chilla ke bata raha hai ki ye 11 aur 13 ka multiple hai.



Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, Volume $V \propto r^2 h$ hota hai. $V$ ka naya ratio $= \frac{143}{100}$. $h$ ka ratio 13 se 11 ho gaya yani $\frac{11}{13}$.
$$r^2 = \frac{V}{h} = \frac{143/100}{11/13} = \frac{169}{100}$$
Iska matlab $r = \frac{13}{10}$. Ab CSA hota hai $2\pi rh$ jo depend karta hai $r \times h$ par.
CSA Ratio $= \frac{13}{10} \times \frac{11}{13} = \frac{11}{10}$. 10 se 11 ho gaya, seedha $10\%$ increment!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula ratne ki zarurat nahi hai. Volume radius ke square par depend karti hai aur CSA linear hota hai. Bas in multipliers ko dhyan me rakhna hai.

Exam Takeaway: Mensuration ke percentage questions me constants ($2\pi$) ko hamesha ignore maar aur bas proportional ratios use kar.

Math FormulaApplication
Cylinder RatiosVol depends on $r^2 \times h$. CSA depends on $r \times h$.

questions_hin.q_hi: A number is divided into two parts in such a way that $75\%$ of the first part is 6 more than $90\%$ of the second part and $80\%$ of the second part is 12 more than $45\%$ of the first part. Then the number is?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, equations banane padenge par unko decimals aur percentages ki bimari se mukt karna padega. Percentages ko direct equations me daal kar simple linear form bana. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Parts ko P aur Q maan le. Eq1: $0.75P - 0.9Q = 6$. Eq2: $0.8Q - 0.45P = 12$. Inhe clean kar 100 se multiply karke aur common divide maarke. Eq1: $75P - 90Q = 600$ (divide by 15 $\implies 5P - 6Q = 40$). Eq2: $80Q - 45P = 1200$ (divide by 5 $\implies 16Q - 9P = 240$). Ab pehli eq ko 9 se aur dusri ko 5 se multiply karke add kar de taaki P udd jaye! $-54Q + 80Q = 360 + 1200 \implies 26Q = 1560 \implies Q = 60$. Q ki value P wali choti equation me daal de, $5P - 360 = 40 \implies 5P = 400 \implies P = 80$. Total Number $= 80 + 60 = 140$. Mazboot algebra ki zarurat thi yahan. Method 2 (Concept Builder): Options se check karne ki galti mat karna kyunki options me total sum diya hai, individual P aur Q nahi. Simultaneous equations hi best hain. Exam Takeaway: Decimal equations ko sabse chhoti integer value me convert kiye bina substitution kabhi mat karna.

questions_hin.q_hi: Kavita owns a commercial property which she let on lease to a third party for five years. Instead of just the lease income, she also gets a fixed annual salary of Rs. 6,00,000. In five years, the total lease income from the property is exactly $50 \%$ of her annual salary. How much money does she earn in total each year?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Annual salary 6 lakh hai. 5 saal ki land income uski ek saal ki salary ka $50 \%$ yani 3 lakh hai. Toh usko property se har saal 60 hazar milte hain. Bacha wala part add kar do.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Seedha verbal logic aur arithmetic lagana hai, koi extra variable nahi chahiye.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Annual Salary} = 6,00,000 \\ \text{5-Year Lease Income} = 50 \% \text{ of } 6,00,000 = 3,00,000 \\ \text{1-Year Lease Income} = \frac{3,00,000}{5} = 60,000 \\ \text{Total Annual Earning} = 6,00,000 + 60,000 = 6,60,000 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Mathematical equation balance karo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let } S = 600000 \\ \text{Let Annual Lease} = L \\ 5 \times L = 0.5 \times S \\ 5L = 0.5 \times 600000 = 300000 \\ L = 60000 \\ \text{Total Earning per year} = S + L = 600000 + 60000 = 660000 $$

Exam Takeaway: Language reading is everything here. In 5 years total lease income di gayi thi, jise 1 year par scale-down karna zaroori tha before adding.
